system.description:
Secret (a griffon, wyvern or hippogriff egg).

Study: someone Trained in Animal Training; 4 weeks of tending and an Animal Training check, DC 12, to hatch it.

  • A hippogriff is full-grown in 6 months, a griffon in a year, a wyvern in 2 years, and can't carry a rider until then.
  • Then 4 weeks and an Animal Training check, DC 15, teach it to bear you as your mount.
  • The egg is used up when it hatches.
  • Taken from the crags of the Giant's Fist.
  • Egg-hunters climb it every spring; most come back empty-handed, and some don't come back.

Monsters & Treasure, Secrets: one of a kind, never sold, placed by the GM. Study it in downtime (Study a Secret); no one can teach it.
